- [USER] User is intrigued by Hadestown and wants to know more about its story and music.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hadestown is a modern retelling of the myth of Orpheus and Eurydice, set in a post-apocalyptic world.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The music in Hadestown is a fusion of folk, rock, blues, and R&B, written by Anaïs Mitchell.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Key characters in Hadestown include:
  - Orpheus
  - Eurydice
  - Hades
  - Persephone
  - Hermes
  - The Fates
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hadestown has won 8 Tony Awards, including Best Musical, Best Book, and Best Score.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The original cast recording of Hadestown features Eva Noblezada as Eurydice, Reeve Carney as Orpheus, and Patrick Page as Hades.
- [USER] User is trying to learn how to play some songs from Dear Evan Hansen on guitar.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for learning musical theater songs on guitar:
  1. Start with simplified arrangements.
  2. Focus on chord shapes.
  3. Work on strumming and picking.
  4. Listen to original recordings.
  5. Practice singing and playing simultaneously.
